gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Audiowide draws its futuristic letters with one unbroken line, like taut string. Noto Sans Duployan follows with a wide-mouthed a and generous counters, so paragraphs of text move along easily and without strain.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera spaces its letters like stepping stones, each one drawn with a plotter-pen line. Oswald is the tight, confident one, packing rows close and strong, while the body font stretches out and lets every round shape breathe.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-elbasa: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display keeps its letters from ever pinching shut, with a pronounced x-height. Noto Sans Elbasan carries long text in large lowercase forms and open terminals, so a full page feels spacious and unhurried.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Audiowide sets tall lowercase letters like tiles, every stroke held to a single monoweight line, with a futuristic hum. Noto Sans Elymaic reads smoothly over a longer passage.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-montserrat-alternates: Montserrat Alternates crowds its chalk-board lowercase up toward the capital line. Over a longer passage it feels bright and open, with round letters whose rims match the stems, while Oswald stays tight, confident and strong above.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-ethiop: Ornate letters that never pinch shut give Almendra Display a literary, storybook flavor, helped by a pronounced x-height. And Noto Sans Ethiopic keeps a longer read steady, with a tall, sturdy lowercase and c terminals that hang far from the bowl.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Futuristic in feel, Audiowide holds every stroke to a texture like neatly bent pipe cleaner, with tall lowercase and tile-like glyphs. And Noto Sans Georgian settles beneath it as a plain sans with open curves and short ascender stems, giving the page a modern, clean footing.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-julius-sans-one: Oswald packs its rows tightly, with a confident, strong look. It does best with that dense punch up front, whereas Julius Sans One does best with wide gaps between letters and open-ended curves that make the sans feel approachable.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-glagol: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display never lets its letters pinch shut. Noto Sans Glagolitic answers its flourish with open round letters and a tall, sturdy lowercase, staying clear and approachable at small sizes.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Neon-tube futurism, with every Audiowide stroke drawn at the same consistency, and glyphs spaced like tiles. But Noto Sans Gothic opens its lowercase into big, bead-like counters and round forms like open parentheses, so a longer passage reads smooth and modern.
